newsitem.title: USA: Fidelity Federal names Davis its new CEO.
newsitem.headline: Fidelity Federal names Davis its new CEO.

text.p: First Fidelity Bancorp said Thursday it named M. Brian Davis, its president and president and chief executive officer, effective November 15.
Davis had been president and chief operating officer.

Davis succeeds Bruce Cordingley, the First Fidelity chairman who stepped down as chief executive in March, the company said. Davis joined the board of directors of First Fidelity in 1992 as an activist shareholder who helped with the transition of United Fidelity bank from a thrift lender to a financial services company, First Fidelity said.
Shares of the thrift holding company gained 1/8 to 10-1/2 Thursday.
